Name: NPC Hairstyles (WIP) - Eight NPCs Complete
Author: FoxyFullmoon
Description:
This idea came to me when modifying other hairstyle mods. I thought, Sebastion has cool hair, why not make his hair playable? So that sparked my idea to make [i]all[/i] NPC hairs playable - and that's exactly what this mod does.

Currently I've only completed eight of the NPCs. If you want a specific NPC done next, leave a comment saying which one and I'll add it to my to-do list.

I'm not a skilled spriter, this is my third attempt at editing sprites, and thus I don't have much experience. If you don't think these hairstyles are good enough quality, feel free to edit them. If you re-upload it, I ask that you only do so on the Nexus and you give proper credit and link back to this mod.

Completed hairstyles: Sebastion, Abigail, Elliot, Penny, Emily, Sam, Haley, Shane
